recommendations.title: Inspect command-and-control exfiltration channels
recommendations.description: Exfiltration over a command-and-control channel is suspected. Block the channel, capture flow metadata and verify what data left the network.

recommendations.title: Block and inspect command-and-control channels
recommendations.description: Possible C2/beaconing behaviour was observed. Sinkhole or block the identified infrastructure, enable TLS inspection for egress and review scheduled outbound flows for beaconing periodicity.

recommendations.title: Block the identified malicious infrastructure
recommendations.description: Threat intelligence marked an indicator of this chain as malicious. Block it at the perimeter, hunt for historical connections and review any host that contacted it.

recommendations.title: Constrain command and scripting interpreters
recommendations.description: Command interpreter activity was observed. Restrict interpreter use to approved administrative paths, enable script block logging and alert on encoded or obfuscated command lines.

recommendations.title: Enable MFA and rate limiting for authentication
recommendations.description: Repeated authentication failures were observed on 22, 3389. Enforce MFA, account lockout / rate limiting and block a source after a bounded number of failures.

recommendations.title: Monitor alternative-protocol egress
recommendations.description: Exfiltration over an alternative protocol (DNS/ICMP/...) is suspected. Enforce DNS egress control, inspect ICMP volume and restrict unauthorised protocols at the perimeter.

recommendations.title: Remediate CVE-2021-44228
recommendations.description: The evidence references CVE-2021-44228. Identify the affected component on the target asset, apply the vendor patch and verify the fix with a targeted scan.

recommendations.title: Review account usage and access policy
recommendations.description: Valid-account abuse is suspected. Review recent logins for the involved accounts, enforce least privilege and rotate credentials used from unexpected sources.

recommendations.title: Control the ingress of tooling and second-stage payloads
recommendations.description: Tool or payload transfer was observed. Restrict outbound downloads, block unauthorised file transfer services and inspect proxy logs.

recommendations.title: Restrict and monitor internal reconnaissance
recommendations.description: Service/port scanning was detected. Segment the network, restrict east-west traffic to required flows and alert on scan-like patterns.

recommendations.title: Monitor host information discovery
recommendations.description: System information discovery was observed. Alert on discovery commands issued from non-administrative contexts.
